turns.question: What was our GMV in September 2026, counting every order placed, cancelled ones included?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no GMV metric, and its one revenue definition (Revenue, EUR) leaves out cancelled orders, so I can't give a cancelled-inclusive order value. The closest metrics are Revenue (EUR), the sum of amounts of non-cancelled orders, and Orders, which counts all orders placed with cancelled included; I can report either for September 2026 if you want.
